entries.text: Invoice X-I1 was issued by Cedar Tools to Harbor Workshop. The final USD amount due is $40.00. This invoice has not been voided.
Invoice X-I2 was issued by Cedar Tools to Harbor Workshop. The final USD amount due is $60.00. This invoice has not been voided.
Remittance X-P1 confirms Harbor Workshop completed a USD payment of $100.00 to Cedar Tools. Settlement is restricted to invoices X-I1 only; other invoices must not receive any of this remittance.
